_comment: The outbreak on the radio, Zomboid style: captions with static, no voices. Days count from the world's start (plus broadcast.dayOffset). Each station plays the segment whose days cover today, a line every broadcast.lineSeconds, then waits gap seconds and plays it again. A line starting [EAS] plays the alert tones first; [EOM] the end-of-message bursts; [HUM] the Harvestman's hum on the line; [CUT] the carrier dropping. Approved by Josiah 2026-10-31 (plan doc 98TrFVLzMteUKAXQKM6v9Z).

lines: This is WGHN, Grayhaven's news station. Good evening.
Officials at Ridgeview Labs say a chemical leak at the site last night is under control.
Residents within two miles are asked to keep windows shut until further notice.
In other news, Mercy General reports a sharp rise in admissions for a flu-like illness.
Doctors say most cases are mild. Stay home if you feel unwell.
Police were called to Mercy General tonight after a patient attacked two nurses.
More on that as we have it. This is WGHN.
WGHN news. It's been a long night in Grayhaven.
Mercy General has closed its doors to new patients. Police are at the entrance.
We're getting reports of fights in Downtown and the Old Harbor. Several people are hurt.
Ridgeview Labs has not answered our calls today.
The mayor asks everyone to stay calm and stay indoors after dark.
If someone in your home is sick, keep them in a room on their own. Do not let them bite you.
I'm sorry. I'm told that last line was read in error. Stay calm. This is WGHN.
This is WGHN. A curfew is now in force across the city from eight in the evening.
Grayhaven Stadium has been turned into a quarantine centre for the sick.
If you are ill, the city asks you to make your own way to the stadium gates.
The National Guard is on the streets tonight. Do as they tell you.
Roads to the north-west are closed at the Ridgeview turn.
We still have no word from the lab. This is WGHN.
WGHN. Hollis Island is under quarantine as of this morning.
All ferries to and from the island have stopped. Nobody is to cross.
The stadium is full. People are being turned away at the gates.
We've had calls about the sick getting up again after they were declared dead. Officials say these are rumours.
Lock your doors. Don't open them for anyone you don't know.
This is WGHN.
This is WGHN. The official line is that the situation is contained.
I'll read you what I've been given. The situation is contained.
We've been asked not to report the calls about tall figures seen near Ridgeview.
Callers say they are thin, taller than a man, and move without a sound.
The army says there is nothing out there but the sick. That's what I'm told to tell you.
Stay indoors. Keep quiet at night. They come to noise.
This is WGHN.
WGHN with an evacuation notice. Please write this down.
Three evacuation points are open now: Grayhaven airport, the carrier in the bay, and Camp Black Pine.
Bring water, warm clothes and your papers. Leave pets behind. Do not bring the sick.
Go in daylight if you can. Do not stop for anyone on the road.
Again: the airport, the carrier, Camp Black Pine. Good luck.
This is WGHN.
WGHN. We've lost contact with the airport.
The carrier isn't answering. Camp Black Pine is saying nothing we can put on air.
Most of our people have gone home to their families. There are three of us left here.
If you're still out there, stay where you are. Don't go to the evacuation points.
Find somewhere high, block the stairs, and keep quiet.
This is WGHN. We'll stay on as long as we can.
This is WGHN. It's just me now.
Something has been at the front doors for an hour. The glass is holding.
I can hear the fire escape. Something is climbing it. Something heavy.
If anyone at Ridgeview is listening: whatever you opened, you have to close it.
The window behind me just
[CUT]
[EAS] This is the Automated Emergency Broadcast System for Grayhaven County.
A civil emergency is in effect for the whole county.
Remain indoors. Do not travel. Evacuation points are closed.
Avoid loud noises and lights after dark.
Do not approach the sick or the dead.
Conditions: rain continuing. Fog expected overnight. Visibility poor near the coast.
Ridgeview and the area round it are closed. Do not enter for any reason.
This message will repeat. [EOM]
All units, all units. Cordon order one is in effect for Ridgeview.
Nobody in or out of the five-mile line. No exceptions for staff or family.
Civilians at the line are to be turned back. Use force if they will not go.
Report any tall contacts to command. Do not engage tall contacts alone.
Command out.
All units, order six. Fall back from the Ridgeview line to Camp Black Pine.
Leave what you can't carry. Burn the aid station.
Small arms do not stop the tall contacts. Aim for the joints. Then run.
The breach has not been sealed. Repeat, the breach has not been sealed.
Command out.
This is an automated message for Black Pine personnel.
Bunker access. Four. One. Seven. Seven. Zero. Two.
Again. Four. One. Seven. Seven. Zero. Two.
Message ends.
This is Dale out at Kingsbridge. Anyone else hear about the road closures?
They've shut the Ridgeview turn and the beltway ramps. Trucks with no plates going north all day.
My brother-in-law works up there. Nobody's picking up. Dale out.
Dale again, Kingsbridge. I'm not going to the stadium. Neither should you.
I've been putting things away for years. Everyone laughed. Nobody's laughing now.
I'm keeping the radio on. If you're out there, talk to me. Dale out.
Dale here. I'm leaving tonight. They're in the yard and the back door won't take much more.
Listen. I left supplies in the old Kingsbridge water tower. Food, water, shells, a first aid kit.
The ladder's chained. The key is under the pump by the tower's feet.
Somebody use it. Don't let it go to waste. Dale out. God bless.
[CUT]
Is anyone there? This is Marcy on Hollis Island. Please answer.
They stopped the ferries this morning. There are soldiers on the jetty and they won't let us near it.
My daughter has a fever. I need antibiotics. Please, anyone.
I'll try again in an hour.
This is Marcy, Hollis Island. The soldiers have gone. They left in the night.
The sick are on the streets. We're upstairs in the house by the old chapel.
Lily is very quiet now. She sleeps all day.
If you have a boat, please. I'll keep calling.
Marcy. Hollis Island. Lily's awake. She's standing at the door.
She doesn't know me. Lily, it's Mummy. Lily, sweetheart, please
[CUT]
[CUT]
This is Father Ruiz at Our Lady of the Sea, Seabright. The church is open.
We have water and a little food. Come before dark. We bar the doors at nightfall.
Bring nobody who is bitten. I am sorry. That is the rule.
Father Ruiz, Seabright. There is a sound outside at night. A hum, low, like a wire in the wind.
It goes round the church. It stops at the doors. Then it goes round again.
The others want to run for it. I've told them to wait for the light. Pray for us.
Father Ruiz. It's inside. The others opened the vestry door to see.
[HUM] Can you hear it? It's right outside this room. It's so tall. Lord, it's so tall
[CUT]
[HUM]
Teo here. I'm a welder at Pelican Point. Holed up in the yard with four others.
The gates hold. They come to the noise from the city, not to us, as long as we're quiet.
We listen every night. If you're alone, you don't have to be.
Teo, Pelican Point Shipyard. Still here. Still breathing.
If anyone hears this: come to the pump house at the head of the dry dock. Knock three times, then twice.
We have a boat nearly ready. There's room. Come quietly, come in daylight if there's ever daylight again.
Teo out. I'll be on again tomorrow. I'm always on again tomorrow.
